introduction: The upstream_sync spec defines the synchronization mechanism by which workspace clones are kept current with their upstream git repositories, including fast-forward advancement of the integration branch, force-push detection and recovery, and nuclear reclone operations. Note: requirements referencing go-git APIs are based on PRD descriptions and should be cross-checked against the installed go-git version before implementation.

glossary.PAT: Personal Access Token; a user-scoped credential that requires explicit scope grants for operations.
glossary.PATCH /workspaces/:slug: REST endpoint for updating mutable workspace fields, including sync_mode.
glossary.POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reclone: REST endpoint that triggers a reclone operation for the specified workspace.
glossary.POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/sync: REST endpoint that triggers an upstream sync operation for the specified workspace.
glossary.WORKSPACE_ROOT: Environment variable or configuration value specifying the root directory under which workspace clone directories are stored.
glossary.WriteAPIError: The apikit function used to write error responses in the standard hub error envelope format.
glossary.afc: The command-line interface for the agent-fox platform hub.
glossary.apikit: The server framework (github.com/txsvc/apikit) providing authentication, CLI scaffolding, and HTTP server infrastructure.
glossary.archive flow: The existing operation (owned by workspace_checkout spec) that attempts to push local commits to upstream before deleting a workspace clone.
glossary.clone_status: Workspace field tracking the state of the local git clone; values are 'pending', 'cloning', 'ready', 'failed', or 'archived'.
glossary.deferred cleanup: A Go deferred function registered by the sync handler that sets sync_status to 'error' if the request context is cancelled mid-sync.
glossary.disabled: A sync_mode value indicating that sync is disabled; sync requests are rejected with a descriptive error.
glossary.diverged: A state where the upstream HEAD is neither equal to nor a descendant of the local integration branch HEAD, indicating a force-push or history rewrite.
glossary.fast-forward: A git branch advancement where the local branch HEAD is moved to a descendant commit without creating a merge commit.
glossary.force-push: A git push that rewrites remote history, causing the local branch to no longer be a direct ancestor of the upstream branch.
glossary.go-git: A pure Go git implementation library used for fetch, ref reading, ref updates, and ancestry checks in this spec.
glossary.head_sha: Workspace field storing the current HEAD SHA of the local integration branch.
glossary.in-memory job queue: The existing Go channel-based job queue used for clone operations, as defined in the workspace_checkout spec.
glossary.integration branch: The primary local branch in a workspace clone that tracks the upstream default branch and is advanced by sync operations.
glossary.last_sync_at: Workspace field storing the RFC 3339 timestamp of the last successful sync.
glossary.pull_only: A sync_mode value indicating that downstream sync is enabled; the hub fetches upstream and fast-forwards the integration branch.
glossary.reclone: A nuclear recovery operation that archives the workspace, deletes the local clone, and re-clones from upstream.
glossary.reset-to-upstream: A recovery operation that resets the local integration branch to match the upstream HEAD, used after force-push or history divergence.
glossary.reset_to_upstream: Query parameter on the sync endpoint that triggers a reset-to-upstream recovery operation instead of a standard sync.
glossary.resolveCloneAuth: Existing function in internal/workspace/clone_auth.go that resolves fetch credentials from the secrets store for a given workspace.
glossary.slug: A unique human-readable identifier for a workspace, used in URL paths and CLI commands.
glossary.startup reconciliation: A step that runs on server startup to reset any workspaces stuck in 'syncing' state to 'error', handling crashes and unclean shutdowns.
glossary.sync_error: Workspace field storing the error message from the most recent failed sync.
glossary.sync_mode: Workspace field controlling whether upstream sync is enabled; values are 'pull_only' (default) or 'disabled'.
glossary.sync_status: Workspace field tracking the current sync state; values are 'idle', 'syncing', or 'error'.
glossary.syncing guard: The check that rejects concurrent sync requests when sync_status is 'syncing', returning HTTP 409.
glossary.trunk: The subdirectory within a workspace's directory (at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/) where the git clone is stored.
glossary.unshallow: A git fetch operation that converts a shallow clone (with truncated history) into a full clone by fetching all missing history.
glossary.upstream_head_sha: Workspace field storing the HEAD SHA of the upstream tracking branch at the time of the last fetch.
glossary.workspaces:read: Permission scope required to read workspace state, including sync status fields.
glossary.workspaces:sync: Permission scope required to trigger sync and reclone operations.

requirements.title: Upstream Sync Algorithm — Fetch and Fast-Forward

user_story.goal: trigger an upstream sync that fetches and fast-forwards the integration branch
user_story.benefit: the workspace clone stays current with upstream without manual git operations

acceptance_criteria.action: sets sync_status to 'syncing', opens the local repository at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ via go-git, resolves fetch credentials using resolveCloneAuth, and calls remote.Fetch() to fetch from upstream
sets sync_status to 'idle', updates last_sync_at to the current RFC 3339 timestamp, updates upstream_head_sha, and returns the workspace object
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: HTTP 200 with workspace JSON: sync_status='idle', last_sync_at set, upstream_head_sha set
acceptance_criteria.condition: upstream HEAD equals local integration branch HEAD

acceptance_criteria.action: fast-forwards the integration branch to upstream HEAD via go-git ref update, updates head_sha and upstream_head_sha, sets sync_status to 'idle', and updates last_sync_at
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: HTTP 200 with workspace JSON: sync_status='idle', head_sha updated, upstream_head_sha updated, last_sync_at set
acceptance_criteria.condition: upstream HEAD is a descendant of local integration branch HEAD (fast-forward possible)

acceptance_criteria.action: updates upstream_head_sha to the fetched value, sets sync_status to 'error', sets sync_error to 'upstream history has diverged; use --reset-to-upstream to recover', and does NOT advance the integration branch
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: HTTP 409 with JSON error body via WriteAPIError; workspace sync_status='error', sync_error set, upstream_head_sha updated
acceptance_criteria.condition: upstream HEAD is not a descendant of local HEAD and not equal to local HEAD (diverged / force-push detected)

correctness_properties.title: Sync status never permanently stuck in syncing
correctness_properties.invariant: sync_status eventually transitions to either 'idle' or 'error'; it never remains 'syncing' indefinitely across server restarts or context cancellations

correctness_properties.title: Fast-forward only advances to a descendant commit
correctness_properties.invariant: the post-sync head_sha is a descendant of the pre-sync head_sha; the integration branch is never moved to a non-descendant commit during a standard sync

correctness_properties.title: upstream_head_sha always reflects the last fetched upstream state
correctness_properties.invariant: upstream_head_sha is updated to the fetched upstream HEAD SHA regardless of whether the integration branch was advanced

correctness_properties.title: Concurrent sync requests are serialized via syncing guard
correctness_properties.for_any: pair of concurrent sync requests for the same workspace
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one sync operation executes at a time per workspace; the second concurrent request receives HTTP 409

correctness_properties.title: Reclone workspace status remains active throughout
correctness_properties.for_any: reclone operation from initiation to clone job completion
correctness_properties.invariant: workspace status is 'active' at every observable point during the reclone lifecycle; it is never set to any other value by the reclone handler

correctness_properties.title: Disabled sync_mode always rejects sync requests
correctness_properties.invariant: every POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/sync request returns HTTP 400 without performing any git operations or state changes

correctness_properties.title: last_sync_at is only updated on successful sync
correctness_properties.for_any: sync operation that results in sync_status='error'
correctness_properties.invariant: last_sync_at is not updated when a sync fails; it retains its previous value

correctness_properties.title: Reset-to-upstream clears sync_error on success
correctness_properties.invariant: sync_error is null and sync_status is 'idle' after a successful reset-to-upstream, regardless of the previous sync_error value

correctness_properties.title: Startup reconciliation runs before HTTP server accepts requests
correctness_properties.invariant: no HTTP request can be processed before the startup reconciliation step completes; all stuck-syncing workspaces are reset before the first request is handled

error_handling.condition: Shallow clone fetch fails due to missing history
error_handling.behavior: Retry with unshallow fetch (best-effort); if retry also fails, set sync_status='error', record sync_error, return HTTP 502 via WriteAPIError
Log a warning and continue with reclone; do not return an error to the caller

error_handling.condition: Reclone local clone directory deletion fails
error_handling.behavior: Return HTTP 500 via WriteAPIError; do not enqueue clone job; workspace clone_status unchanged
CLI exits with non-zero exit code and prints a message requiring --confirm; no API call made

error_handling.condition: Startup reconciliation database query or update fails
error_handling.behavior: Log the error and abort server startup with non-zero exit code
